structured_output.what_is_happening: A token launched on Pump.fun about 40 minutes ago, named for the X user @parafactual, who is part of the AI/LLM-culture circle around @repligate (Janus). According to the project description, trading fees go to @parafactual through UsePaid. The only social link is a repligate status post. The token migrated to PumpSwap about 80 seconds after creation. Its price is up about 420–545% over the hour, market cap is about $298k, and liquidity is about $49k. Hourly volume of about $865k is roughly 19x liquidity. There are about 2,700 unique buyers against 2,200 sellers. Momentum was still positive at collection time, with the last 5 minutes up 30–80%. At least 10 same-name copycats have appeared, and all of them were launched after this one.

narrative.description: This is a fee-routing token tied to a real, niche-famous person in AI Twitter (parafactual), and it links to a post by repligate. The model is the one Bags and UsePaid use, where a creator is 'adopted' and receives the fees. That can pull in attention from a real community if the person acknowledges the token or the repligate crowd engages with it.
narrative.why_spreading: The token is anchored to a repligate post and a known account in the AI-consciousness and simulator community. The copycats show that traders are chasing the name. Without X data, I can't confirm whether parafactual has endorsed the token or even noticed it.

token_connection.why_this_token: It was created first, at 1790207728, before every other same-name token. It has by far the deepest liquidity that isn't in a dying pool, and it carries the UsePaid fee link to the named person's account, which makes it the likely canonical fee token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are about 10 same-name clones. Two of them (E8x1…, which had $1.07M volume in an hour, and ELTV…, 准事实) have real liquidity and could split attention. Most of the others already have zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: Several signals point to heavy bot and bundler activity. GMGN tags 497 wallets as bundlers, the bot/degen rate is 77%, top bundler traders account for 32.6%, and the token migrated within 80 seconds of creation. The creator address is a mass-launcher wallet with about 166k tokens, likely the UsePaid deployer, so its history doesn't reflect on this specific token. On the other side, there are about 2,700 unique buyers, 53 smart wallets and 7 renowned wallets. Top-10 holders hold about 21%, the dev holds nothing, the LP is burned and there are no paid DexScreener boosts.
authenticity.uncertainty: I have no X data, so I can't tell whether parafactual or repligate has engaged with the token, and that is the main thing that separates a runner from a flash pump.

structural_risks: 19x hourly turnover driven by bots, so this could be wash-heavy and the momentum could collapse quickly
The token must double from an entry that is already after a 5x+ pump, which means reaching a market cap of about $600k or more
Mass bundler wallets could dump together
The named person might disavow the token or decline the fees

structured_output.counterargument: The token has several things in its favour. It is the canonical first token for a real, recognisable AI-Twitter figure, and it links to a repligate post. It has burned LP, a dev holding of zero, top-10 concentration of only 21%, smart and KOL wallets present, and buying momentum that was still accelerating. Fee-to-creator tokens for AI-community figures have run to multi-million market caps when the person engages, and a $300k market cap leaves plenty of room. If parafactual acknowledges the token, it could easily double from entry within 6 hours.
unknowns: Whether parafactual or repligate has acknowledged or claimed the fees
What the price will be at entry, 25 minutes after detection, since it could have spiked or dumped by then
How much of the volume is wash trading by bundlers
Whether a clone captures the narrative

source_coverage.notes: This is the no-internet condition, so the judgment rests on the evidence packet alone.

structured_output.thesis: This is the canonical fee token for a real, niche AI-Twitter personality, and its structure is reasonably clean: LP burned, no dev holdings, low concentration. Against that, the flow is dominated by bots and bundlers, the token is already up more than 5x, and the paper position enters after that pump. Doubling depends on the person engaging with the token, which I can't see. Because the LP is burned, a liquidity pull is unlikely, but the token fading toward death is quite possible. My runner probability is below the break-even of 1/3, though not by much.
